name: Wacky Dungeons
author: Addicting Games
description: Wacky Dungeons is a free clicker game. Welcome to the dungeon, the wacky dungeon. This is an incremental clicker-style game where you'll be following the patterns and clicking through a variety of levels in order to make it to the end of the dungeon and your escape. This game will test your tactical ability, your ability to strategize, and your clicker finger as you smash various dungeon baddies as you struggle onward towards redemption. Wacky Dungeon is as dangerous as any other game but is also a little light-hearted. Don't expect a grimdark dive into the void with this game. This is a world of fun and laughter even though it's also a dangerous slog through a bevy of baddies. Collect treasure, upgrade your items and make it to the top of the pops in this epic dungeon dive that only requires you to point, click, and let 'er rip.
